correctness.rationale: Projected zonotope area is the sum of the absolute projected pair determinants with full generators v_i, giving 15 cross products of length 2φ. Maximizing the support function over the sphere is the same as maximizing the norm over signed sums; Cauchy–Schwarz gives exactly the radial equality directions. For the minimum the area is positive and linear on the relative interior of every arrangement cell or arc; its only positive stationary value there is a strict maximum, so only the boundary intersections need be tested. Independent exact arithmetic reproduced all 32768 signs and all 105 pair intersections: squared endpoints 250+110√5 and 306+134√5, 60 minimizing pairs giving precisely ± the six normalized generators, and 120 maximizing signs with distinct rays. The independent absolute angular cosine counts are 30,30,30,15 for φ/2,(φ−1)/2,1/2,0. In the two-dimensional span of a pair of normals the projected squared radius of a uniform spherical point has mean 2/3, with uniform angle; integrating the absolute cosine product gives the displayed formula. The diagonal contribution is 20φ², and the four cosine classes give the cited second moment. The variance calculation gives 0.141612642020164; the ratio is the quotient of the squared endpoints followed by a square root.
residual_risks: The exact replay certifies the finite counts and arithmetic, not formal verification of the geometric reduction; the latter was checked separately. The result is fixed-scale orthographic area, not section area or a unit-edge calculation.

evidence: The exact projection body has 120 vertices all at equal radius and regular 4-, 6- and 10-gon facets of edge 4φ. The general sources supply the zonotope, icosahedral and projection-body context rather than this fixed-scale identification.
broader_coverage.reasoning: With vertex radius R and edge a, the squared center-to-regular-m-gon distance is R²−(a/(2 sin(π/m)))². Hence the 12 decagons are exactly the nearest facets. The six v_i lines are precisely their normals since v_i is perpendicular to its five incident cross products and to no other cross product (nonzero triple determinants).

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Fifteen square classes give 15 perpendicular pairs, ten hexagonal classes give 30 at cosine 1/2, and the six decagonal classes each give five pairs at each of φ/2 and (φ−1)/2. Thus the published facet data give all four multiplicities with no new search or enumeration. Substituting into the standard spherical two-direction identity gives the exact second moment, and the one-direction identity gives the mean. Replaying all sign sums and arrangement pairs is a useful verification method, not a distinct invariant.

originality.rationale: Distinct published Resultary record 2cbe10fe2324 gives the exact fixed-scale projection body, whose support function is the assigned brightness. Its identification with the vertex-transitive uniform truncated icosidodecahedron and its explicit regular facet-direction classification mechanically imply the extrema, all equality sets, and the pair-cosine multiplicities for the second moment. The mean is already Cauchy’s formula. This is demonstrated equivalent coverage by implication, not a claim that the later indexed path predates the frozen work or that it prints the same formulas verbatim.

The submitted enumeration does not overcome this value criterion for an already mechanically implied invariant.
